sentence: This project uses mouse models of gastric cancer to test antibodies that target a receptor and tries to find out why tumors resist therapies.
This project tests whether large language models can pull useful patient data elements out of pathology reports.
This project provides a program that uses genetic approaches to address challenges in biomedical research.
This project tests whether audio-recorded verbal telephone communication with patients who have heart failure can help predict hospitalizations and emergency department visits.
This project studies how an mRNA demethylase called fat mass and obesity-associated protein shapes tolerance and reward from mu opioids.
This project studies the genetic, molecular, and cellular mechanisms by which esophageal squamous cell cancer begins and progresses.
This project studies the role of B-cells in the anti-tumor immune response in triple negative breast cancer.
This project builds methods to make peptides, design proteins, and find and describe factors involved in interactions between HIV and its host.
This project looks for the genetic and genomic factors and pathways that drive prostate cancer toward a lethal form.
This project builds a human cell-culture model to study how stimulants such as cocaine drive inflammation and neuronal dysfunction in HIV.
This project develops digital health tools by bridging medical research and software engineering.
This project studies a signaling pathway in dendritic cells that regulates the immune response in autoimmune diseases.
This project tries to find which microbial, metabolic, and host factors raise infection risk in patients whose gut carries antibiotic-resistant organisms.
This project upgrades a magnet and adds a solid-state CryoProbe to study the structure of membrane proteins, lipids, enzymes, fungi, and bacteria.
This project studies how a group of astrocytes in the striatum controls neurons to cause repetitive behaviors in mice.
This project uses imaging mass cytometry to describe the molecular architecture around senescent cells in aging tissues.
This project uses neural stem cells to carry an oncolytic adenovirus into tumors and tests the safety of repeat administration through an implantable catheter system.
This project uses sperm collected from the same individual at different times, and a mouse model, to study how sperm DNA changes with cancer therapy.
This project studies how the hippocampus and the sensory cortical region for taste coordinate to form and recall memories of taste experiences.
